# The World in My Dreams

V2 slot: **09**. Stable folder: `the-gioi-trong-mo-cua-toi`.

The author-supplied Dream World board is preserved at `../../references/design/data colletion - dream world.png`. `../../scripts/cut_dream_world_board.py` cuts screen assets for the chapter's rotating ring, stationary family-dinner centre, shared-cover preview, rectangular reading illustration, and the standalone Borrowed Reel modes. The artwork is a visual interpretation of the approved essay; it is not a documentary record of the children or their family.

Edit identity and state in `chapter.json`; keep author prose in `source/` and production recipes in `production.json`. See [the chapter workflow](../../docs/PRODUCTION_WORKFLOW.md) and [product status](docs/PRODUCT_STATUS.json).

The original edition files are preserved. Its chapter number, proof labels and narration status remain historical facts; they are not a completed v2 release. Original metadata lives in `references/original-edition/`.
